messages:
incident-bot: @jordan_oncall P1 alert — customer corpB (VPC) reports missing traces and partial logs during a recent traffic spike :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Symptoms: traces not appearing in tenant index, logs 403 on ES access for corpB-svc-account, metrics for p95 token latency missing. Started 2026-02-15T04:34:12Z.

jordan_oncall: I’m on it. Can someone confirm whether this is an index/role partitioning issue vs a routing problem?

emma_sre: I saw the spike in the prod ingress around 04:32, we routed requests to Dedicated pool corpB-dedicated-1 which had a kube restart around then. Traces disappeared after restart. Logs show ES requests returning 403 for corpB-svc-account.

raj_infra: 403 implies auth/role mismatch. Recent RBAC change rolled last week touched the ES role mapping for tenant service accounts. I’m checking the role bindings in the VPC connector.

sophie_support: CorpB is escalating — they can’t see traces in their Splunk/ES viewer and want a window for post-incident auditing. Lia, can you patch them in?

lia_custsuccess: On call with CorpB infra. They confirm they can’t access their trace index and see 403s when fetching _search on their tenant index. They also provided an ephemeral key (will paste in secure channel) for verification.

jordan_oncall: OK immediate mitigation paths: 1) temporarily route corpB traces to shared-read replica index (less secure but restores visibility) OR 2) lift the newest RBAC change for corpB-es-role so their service account regains access. Preference?

emma_sre: Option 2 is less blast radius if we can patch quickly. Raj — can you roll back the role mapping change for just corpB? If not possible in <15m, do option 1.

raj_infra: Rolling back role mapping for single tenant is messy in the current PR. I can apply an override in IAM-bridge to re-add corpB-svc-account to corpB-es-role. Doing it now.

security-oncall: Quick reminder — if we re-add privileges, we need an audit entry + ticket and to inform compliance. Lia, please capture customer consent.

lia_custsuccess: CorpB approves temporary fix for visibility. They need logs/traces for 04:30–05:00 window for compliance.

jordan_oncall: Raj — status?

raj_infra: Applied override to IAM-bridge, re-granted corpB-svc-account -> corpB-es-role. Please validate.

emma_sre: I can see traces reappearing in the corpB trace index now. p95 metrics back-populating slowly.

corpB-svc-account-check: (automated) auth success for corpB-svc-account when querying /corpB-traces/_search

jordan_oncall: Good. Now we still need to figure root cause — what caused role mapping to change during the deploy window? Any deploys touching IAM-bridge?

raj_infra: There was a config push yesterday that rolled out a consolidated role map. It had a flaky merge which removed one tenant line for corpB (bad diff). PR author is @mike-orch. I’ll open a revert PR and pin.

emma_sre: Also confirm why traces vanished during the kube restart on corpB-dedicated-1. Might be ordering: pod came up but the KV cache for tenant routing cleared and requests hit a fallback path with insufficient auth headers.

jordan_oncall: Action items:
- raj_infra: open revert PR for role map + postmortem entry (ASAP).
- emma_sre: gather trace timeline and sample IDs for 04:30–04:50. Put in evidence folder.
- lia_custsuccess: collect customer confirmation for temporary override and their requested audit window.
- security-oncall: start compliance ticket.
- jordan_oncall: coordinate mitigation notes and close the page when confirmed restored.

sophie_support: For audit: corpB needs the logs and traces exported. We should provide an export bundle (gz) and instructions for re-ingest if they want.

emma_sre: Export ready. Command I used to pull spans:```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <corpB-ephemeral-key>" \
  "https://es.internal/corpB-traces/_search?q=timestamp:[2026-02-15T04:30:00Z TO 2026-02-15T05:00:00Z]&size=10000" \
  | jq .hits.hits > corpB_04_30_to_05_00.jsonl.gz\```
Note: replace header with ephemeral key we stored in secure channel.

jordan_oncall: Good. Also we should add a short-lived monitoring alert for role-mapping diffs. Raj — can you add a webhook to the config repo that creates a PR check failing on tenant removals?

raj_infra: Will add a pre-merge linter rule to catch tenant line deletions and a CI job to reject. ETA 2d. Opening tracking ticket: INFRA-1227.

security-oncall: I created compliance ticket COMP-889 with the timeline. Lia, please attach the customer's written approval.

lia_custsuccess: Approval attached. CorpB asked for a brief recap for their security team. I drafted something and put it in the thread.

jordan_oncall: Are we confident everything is back to normal for the customer? Any residual gaps (metrics, logs) we still need to surface?

emma_sre: Traces and logs are back. Metrics had a short partition lapse — we need to backfill p95 token latency using aggregator job. I’m kicking off a backfill now. Should finish in ~20m.

raj_infra: Confirmed no other tenants affected. This was a role-mapping patch regression.

jordan_oncall: OK I’ll mark page resolved once backfill completes and customer confirms access. Leaving on-call to emma in 10m for post-incident followup. @emma_sre you accept handoff?

emma_sre: Accepting handoff. I’ll run the backfill verification and assemble evidence for the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident P1 (corpB-obsv-access) acknowledged by emma_sre. Handoff recorded.

sophie_support: CorpB confirmed they can view their traces and received the export. They asked if we can schedule a 1:1 to review hardening. Lia to coordinate.

lia_custsuccess: Scheduled 1:1 for 2026-02-16 15:00 UTC.

jordan_oncall: Closing page. Open postmortem doc and assign leads: raj_infra (fix role mapping CI), emma_sre (root cause + backfill), security-oncall (compliance artifacts).

emma_sre: Postmortem started: PM-INC-2026-02-15-corpB-obsv-access. I’ll populate with timelines and remediation steps.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved and closed by jordan_oncall at 2026-02-15T05:52:58Z. Postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-INC-2026-02-15-corpB-obsv-access

jordan_oncall: Thanks team — well handled. Notes for follow-up: add tenant-role-mapping test in CI, consider stronger guards on IAM-bridge rollouts, and add a docs snippet for "how to request temporary read access during incidents".

emma_sre: Adding that doc to runbook.

sophie_support: Closing thread once postmortem is published.

security-oncall: I'll add remediation verification step to the compliance ticket after PR merges.

jordan_oncall: Done. Great job everyone. :thumbsup:
